name: save-tagged-docs-sweep

deploy.workflow_name: Save Tagged Docs in Notion — daily sweep
deploy.description: Daily backstop for save-tagged-docs-to-notion. Lists the newest 100 Readwise Reader documents tagged `sendtonotion` (via the work.flowers 'Readwise Reader (Unofficial)' app's new_tagged_document read) and creates an 'Article Share' Social Content page for any tagged since 2026-08-29 that the shared dedup Table is missing. Exists because Zapier bug W6ZE93-VMEWP makes the trigger Zap fire once per document, ever, so a tag added after Reader's auto-tagging is dropped. Retire once Zapier ships the fix.

trigger.trigger_note: Daily at 8:00 AM account time, weekends included. The tick payload is ignored; the clock comes from a ctx.step. Schedule by Zapier needs no connection (same as spot-accepted-sweep-to-notion and gcal-block-sweep).
trigger.manual_run_note: trigger-workflow <id> --input '{"dryRun":true}' lists and classifies without writing anything.

connections_note: `notion_wf` is the work.flowers Notion connection (never the Knoxx one). `reader` is the 'Readwise Reader (1.0.0) #6' connection on App233250CLIAPI, the private work.flowers-built Readwise Reader app — NOT the official Readwise app (App228555CLIAPI) the trigger Zap uses, which has no list/search action and whose credentials Zapier's relay won't attach to sdk.fetch. new_tagged_document was verified through the MCP connector on 2026-10-14: it returned the newest 100 sendtonotion documents, each with tags.sendtonotion.created.

tables.01KKNC03EA4Z5Y0KR8H6TP2A8K: Readwise Reader Documents — the dedup ledger OWNED by save-tagged-docs-to-notion (Reader document id -> Notion page id). Read here to skip documents already turned into pages, and written with a row for each page this sweep creates, so the two Zaps are safe side by side.

notion_data_sources.14591b07-11ac-8187-934a-000b1a3a474d: Social Content — 'Article Share' idea pages, same properties as save-tagged-docs-to-notion.
